candidates: Exactly frozen Decision36 top100 per dev query; no retrieval/source injection.
controls: Same OpenAI model/dimensions/query vectors for concat and separate; concat document vectors and dev query vectors reused from full-run cache.
followup: Prespecified after pure-semantic outcomes; distinct experiment identity. Exploratory cached-score follow-up, not independent confirmation.
hypothesis: Field separation can help same-model semantic ordering; retaining lexical evidence may close the gap to the current hybrid baseline.
interpretation: Candidate reranking, not field-specific full-corpus retrieval. Exploratory dev results conditional on current labels.
labels: Frozen shared snapshot including human overrides; no judge API calls. Incomplete graded comparisons withheld; source comparisons remain valid.
scope: 100 dev queries only; body=abstract, no full text; no held-out test.
scoring: 25% candidate-max-normalized original BM25 (including authors/title2x) +75% candidate-max-normalized semantic score, where semantic is concat cosine or t*title_cosine+(1-t)*abstract_cosine. Same candidate100 normalization for every setting, fixed weights, baseline ties. Reorder prefixes10/100.
